top_macro_signals: SEBI and RBI tightening risk architectures while accelerating instant digital rails (Account Aggregator, vKYC).
Retail FinTechs pivoting rapidly from pure discounted broking to high-yield MTF and advisory cross-sell lines.
Automated self-serve servicing (>80%) and lower cost-to-serve emerging as the defining drivers of P&L resilience.

briefing_cards.headline: Sensex, Nifty muted a day after sharp rally, IT stocks extend gains. What lies ahead for Dalal Street?
briefing_cards.summary: Indian equities traded nearly flat after a sharp rally in the previous session, with IT stocks extending gains while pharma shares declined. Analysts flagged elevated US bond yields and crude oil prices as headwinds, even as short-covering and hopes of tax relief supported sentiment.
briefing_cards.pl_impact: Opportunities to optimize CAC payback and expand high-yield cross-sell corridors (PMS, structured notes) across the active digital client base.
briefing_cards.action_trigger: Engage peer group on product-led growth loops and automated lifecycle servicing.
